نفتري (form VIII)
# نَفْتَرِي (naftarī) /naf.ta.riː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَى (iftarā)
# نَفْتَرِيَ (naftariya) /naf.ta.ri.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَرَى (iftarā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
